title: Edges from the Initial Vertex
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over bits, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $s,v$ be natural numbers. There is an edge from vertex $0$ to vertex $v+2$ at radius $s$ exactly when the encoding of $x$, configuration code $v$, and radius $s$ belongs to the machine's initial-configuration language.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over bits
